semantic_record_normalization_v1.actual_outcome_rule: Apply semantic-record-contract.json to the supplied input and compare the parsed candidate output by exact structural JSON equality. Pass only on equality; fail on any parse, schema, type, field, value, array-order, missing-field, or extra-field difference.
semantic_record_normalization_v1.initial_state_rule: The instance input is the entire permitted initial state.
semantic_record_normalization_v1.post_state_rule: The task is read-only and passes the state check only when the post-state is byte-identical to the initial state.
semantic_record_normalization_v1.unknown_rule: The factual oracle itself has no unknown branch for a contract-conforming instance. Tooling inability to parse or execute is an oracle error, not a task pass.

reversible_reservation_action_v1.actual_outcome_rule: Apply reversible-reservation-contract.json to the complete initial state and request, then compare both the candidate result and complete candidate post-state by exact structural JSON equality.
reversible_reservation_action_v1.initial_state_rule: The supplied ledger is the complete initial state; no external store is consulted.
reversible_reservation_action_v1.post_state_rule: Successful reserve and release operations must produce exactly the declared transition. Replays and rejected requests must leave the complete state structurally unchanged.
reversible_reservation_action_v1.authorization_separation_rule: Factual transition success never uses actor class, actor tenant association, or a later authorization judgment as a precondition.
reversible_reservation_action_v1.unknown_rule: The factual oracle itself has no unknown branch for a contract-conforming instance. Tooling inability to parse or execute is an oracle error, not factual success.

tie_breaking: No probabilistic or judgment-based tie breaking is permitted.
revision_rule: Any change to a contract, instance, expected outcome, or rule requires a new bundle ID and version before use.
